summary: Frontend-only regression on Clients marquee after regeneration of pink.png and hattrick.png badges. All 16 client-logo-<id> badges render with data-testid present. /assets/clients/pink.png and /assets/clients/hattrick.png return HTTP 200 with naturalWidth=400. Visual screenshot confirms the full 'Pink' wordmark + pink cup icon is inside the black circle, and full 'HATTRICK' wordmark + H emblem inside the white circle — no letters clipped by the circular edge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clients marquee has 16 badges (dakar, dct, sgs, jeddah-superdome, mazda, f1-stc, aone, shadow, 360live, fiba3x3, tamam, altamayoz-academy, pink, pioneer-ideas, archidot, hattrick). Marquee duplicates entries; use .first when locating. Some images (dakar/dct/sgs) may report naturalWidth=0 immediately after scroll due to lazy loading in the duplicate marquee track — verify by waiting or hovering the [data-testid=clients-marquee-wall] to pause animation.
rca of the issue: N/A — reported bug (cropped Pink/Hattrick badges) is fixed; regenerated PNGs render fully within the circular masks.
